summary: Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 13,683,634 shares of common stock and 6,004,378 warrants at an aggregate price of $5.481 per unit, with warrants exercisable at $5.481 per share. The offering is dilutive and non-special-situation, as it is a routine capital raise to fund operations. No tender offer, M&A, or restructuring is involved. The stock closed at $6.09 on the prior day. Proceeds are ~$75M before expenses; delivery expected July 1, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for dilution pressure on the stock.
